messages:
Maria: Heads-up — starting v2 canary for shard-shim routing at 22:00 UTC. pin=75% for mobile-prod. Observed a gateway header negotiation quirk during dry-run, posting logs.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: release/v2-shard-shim. Start ETA 22:00 UTC.

Ajay: which clients get the new header? mobile SDKs or gateway-only?

Maria: mobile SDKs 3.x and gateway (edge-proxy). We set a client-side header X-Client-Compat: v2

Sophie: saw a regression in header normalization in staging — some clients send `x-client-compat` lowercase and our gateway was case-sensitive. Repro steps:
```
curl -H "x-client-compat: v2" https://api.redwood.com/endpoint
# got 426 from gateway
```

Jordan: oof. Is the shim handling header-case-insensitivity? If not, that will break older SDKs that backfill differently.

Maria: Not yet. I propose a short-lived shim that normalizes to `X-Client-Compat` and adds fallback detection. Plan: enable shim in canary, pin 30% initial, monitor 5m windows. Rollback if 4xx from client increases by >2% or latency spike >200ms p50.

Ajay: SGTM. Will update release notes and add migration note for SDK teams. @sophie can you run a quick compatibility sweep across observed UA strings?

Sophie: on it. running query now. ETA 20m. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Canaries started on shard-a,b. 30% traffic split. Monitor: /deploys/1749999999

Maria: If we see errors, immediate rollback plan: `deploy-bot rollback release/v2-shard-shim` then toggle pin back to 100% v1. Announce in #customer-impact if rollback.

oncall-bot: Alerting policy active — will page if error budget breach.

Sophie: quick update — found 1.2% of traffic (old SDKs) use lowercase header. Will create quickfix in shim to be safe.

Ajay: added note to release notes: "Shim will normalize client headers for 72h; clients should migrate to canonical header." Also added a client backfill job for older SDK versions.

Maria: ok enabling shim in canary now. Standby for metrics. :shipit: 

deploy-bot: Canary health: 22:06 UTC — error rate +0.3% (within thresholds), latency +15ms.

Jordan: looks stable. Slowly ramp to 75% over next 30m per plan.

Maria: Ramp started. keep eyes on error rate and any new 426/400s. I'll post final roll completion when at 75%.

Sophie: if anything spikes, I can flip the shim flag off on gateway within 90s.

deploy-bot: Rollout reached 75% at 22:35 UTC. No automatic rollback triggered.

Maria: Done. release notes link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RN-452

Ajay: will ping mobile eng to schedule SDK patch PR to normalize header.

Maria: thanks team. Thread closed unless issues. :white_check_mark:
